title: Solve sin x = 1
text:
sin x = 1 only at x = 90° (plus full rotations)

General solution: x = 90° + 360°n

title: Solve sin x = -1/2
text:
Reference angle: sin 30° = 1/2, so ref angle = 30°

Since sin x is NEGATIVE, x is in Q3 or Q4:
- Q3: 180° + 30° = 210°
- Q4: 360° - 30° = 330°

General solution: x = 210° + 360°n or x = 330° + 360°n

title: Complete General Solution
text:
Combining all solutions:
$$x = 90° + 360°n$$ or $$x = 210° + 360°n$$ or $$x = 330° + 360°n$$

where n is any integer.
